titles: 海岸步道 · 周末行程
zh-CN.summary: 从灯塔出发，沿海边木栈道步行到旧港。在观景台停下来拍日落。
zh-CN.request: 我们周六下午从灯塔出发，想在旧港看日落。能把散步路线和需要带的东西整理一下吗？
zh-CN.answer:
可以。把观景台安排在最后一段，拍完日落后到旧港吃晚饭。

| 时间 | 地点 | 安排 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 15:30 | 灯塔广场 | 集合，补满水壶 |
| 16:00 | 海边木栈道 | 沿途拍照，在长椅休息 |
| 17:10 | 旧港观景台 | 架好相机，等日落 |

带上防风外套、水和备用电池。出发前再看一次天气预报。
zh-CN.detail: 周六下午 · 灯塔至旧港
zh-CN.gear: 防风外套、饮用水、相机和备用电池。

en-US.summary: Walk from the lighthouse to the old harbor along the boardwalk. Stop at the lookout in time for sunset.
en-US.request: We’re leaving from the lighthouse on Saturday afternoon and want to catch sunset at the old harbor. Can you put together a route and a packing list?
en-US.answer:
Save the lookout for the last stop, then head down to the old harbor for dinner.

| Time | Stop | Plan |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 3:30 PM | Lighthouse square | Meet up and fill water bottles |
| 4:00 PM | Coastal boardwalk | Take photos and stop at the benches |
| 5:10 PM | Harbor lookout | Set up the camera before sunset |

Bring a windbreaker, water and a spare battery. Check the forecast again before leaving.
en-US.detail: Saturday afternoon · Lighthouse to old harbor
en-US.gear: A windbreaker, drinking water, a camera and a spare battery.
